subject: gulf_war,freight
text: Iran deploys new tactics against ships; two vessels struck in Strait of Hormuz. Brent rose to about $106.32 early on 14 Oct after two vessels were hit. Kpler: only 2.9m barrels moved through Hormuz on 11 Oct vs 17.1m b/d pre-war.

subject: inflation,fed_hike
text: US September CPI comes in hot at about 3.7%; October Fed hike odds jump to about 47%. Energy-driven inflation lifted rate-hike bets from about 20%. S&P 500 fell 0.6%, chipmakers led losses; 10-year yield near 5.33%.

subject: russia_war,jet_fuel
text: Russia says Ukrainian drones hit Saratov and Ryazan refineries despite Trump's 'energy ceasefire'. Kyiv denies the strikes. The energy ceasefire announced by Trump is unconfirmed by either side.

subject: sanctions,jet_fuel
text: US moves to lift wartime sanctions on Russian diesel to lower pump prices. Controversial deal aimed at US fuel prices before the midterms.

subject: election_reform
text: Brazil first round: Flavio Bolsonaro 47.0%, Lula 45.2%; Ibovespa jumps 7.7% to a record. Real strengthened below 5 per dollar as markets priced tighter fiscal policy. Runoff on 25 Oct.

subject: gulf_war
text: Iran says Hormuz stays closed until the US accepts its seven-point plan. Top negotiator sets conditions including an end to the naval blockade and release of assets.

subject: opec_cut
text: OPEC+ seven keep November output unchanged; next meeting 1 November. Group holds policy while Hormuz disruption limits what it can deliver.

subject: wheat,weather
text: FAO Food Price Index rises to 136.0 in September, highest since Nov 2022; wheat +6.3%. Black Sea logistics and North American dryness lifted cereals; maize at a 3-year high.

subject: import_rules
text: India's BIS quality-control order on aluminium cans takes effect for large firms in October. Deferred from 2025; small firms follow in January 2027 and micro firms in April 2027. Can supply already tight.

subject: freight,tankers,brent
text: US weighs easing shadow-fleet sanctions to cut record tanker freight rates. US officials are discussing letting sanctioned tankers carry non-Russian, non-Iranian crude and products under Treasury authorisation; Energy Secretary Wright said the aim is to cut record freight rates. Analysts expect limited near-term effect; no formal change announced.

subject: ai_chips,memory,risk_on,jp_exporters
text: Asian AI stocks crash: Kospi plunges about 8% triggering circuit breaker, Nikkei down about 5%. After the hot US CPI, Korea's Kospi fell as much as 8.2% to 5,514.96, triggering a 20-minute circuit breaker (its 10th this year), while the Nikkei fell about 5% as AI and chip stocks tumbled amid AI financing worries including CoreWeave debt concerns.

subject: russia_war,jet_fuel,brent
text: Ukraine to resume strikes on Russian refineries, Zelenskyy tells FT. Zelenskyy told the Financial Times Ukraine will restart strikes on Russian oil refineries after a three-day pause under Trump's 'energy ceasefire', saying Russia kept attacking Ukraine's energy system.

subject: fed_hike,usd,us_yields
text: Dollar retreats from 18-month high as Fed's Bowman and Daly temper hike bets. The dollar index slipped to about 102.06 after the hot CPI pushed it to an 18-month high; Bowman and Daly said the Fed can wait for a clearer picture before the Oct 27-28 meeting, and the 10-year yield fell to a three-week low near 5.13%.

subject: bitcoin,ether,crypto_stocks
text: Bitcoin drops below $81,000 with nearly $1 billion of crypto liquidations; spot ETFs see $261M outflow. Bitcoin fell about 3.6% to roughly $80,764 in Asian trading as risk-off spread from Korean and Japanese equities; nearly $1 billion of crypto positions were liquidated and US spot bitcoin ETFs posted $261.46 million of net outflows.

subject: jpy
text: Japan's Katayama renews yen intervention warning after hot US CPI. Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said Japan is ready to act in currency markets again if needed after the yen hit its weakest level this month following US CPI, adding the US-Japan stance is unchanged since July's joint intervention.

subject: inr
text: Rupee gains 31 paise to 94.86 per dollar on RBI measures; India WPI inflation at 11.39%. The rupee rose to 94.86 in early trade from 95.17, helped by RBI steps including a 20% reserve requirement on large dollar hedges and a special dollar window for oil companies; WPI inflation accelerated to 11.39% from 9.92%.

subject: weather,rice,wheat
text: India drought deepens: Karnataka 32% rain deficit, Maharashtra declares 304 talukas drought-hit. Karnataka recorded a 32% rainfall deficit, reported as the highest since 1918, and Maharashtra declared 304 talukas drought-affected; reports warn of lower rabi crop acreage.
source: New Indian Express / India Tribune / Economic Times

subject: copper
text: Philex ends Padcal copper mine strike with five-year labour deal. Philex Mining workers at the Padcal copper-gold mine in Benguet ended a strike that began Oct 11 after agreeing a five-year labour deal.

subject: import_rules
text: India makes BIS certification mandatory for packaged water bottles. A new rule requires a BIS mark on packaged water bottles, extending India's quality-control order regime.

subject: jet_fuel,consumer
text: Maine faces record-high heating oil prices. Maine heating oil prices hit record highs heading into winter, with rural Aroostook County expected to be hit hardest.

subject: risk_on,em_fx
text: IMF warns energy shock and AI correction threaten Asia's growth outlook. The IMF flagged the war-driven energy shock and the risk of an AI-stock correction as key downside risks to Asia's growth.

subject: crypto_reg
text: Thailand sets framework for crypto ETFs. Thailand's regulators set out a framework for crypto exchange-traded funds.

subject: f_india,inr
text: Fairfax-led group agrees ₹52,877 crore deal for IDBI Bank stake. A Prem Watsa-led Fairfax group agreed a ₹52,877 crore deal for a stake in IDBI Bank; IDBI shares fell about 6% while LIC rose about 1%.

subject: f_india
text: Reliance Jio IPO priced at about ₹10 lakh crore valuation. Reliance Jio set the price band for its IPO, implying a valuation of about ₹10 lakh crore, with a ₹2,500 crore quota for RIL shareholders; telecom stocks rose up to 3.6%.

subject: sanctions,freight
text: UK finance minister calls for tighter Russian shipping sanctions. Britain's finance minister called for tighter sanctions on Russian shipping, pushing against the US move toward easing shadow-fleet rules.

subject: gulf_war,brent,freight,airlines
text: Houthi missile hits Saudi Aramco headquarters in Dhahran; Houthis vow more attacks on Saudi oil sites. A Houthi ballistic missile struck an office tower at Aramco's Dhahran complex late on 13 October, causing a fire; Saudi officials said there were no injuries and operations continued. Brent settled near $106 on 14 October and the Houthis vowed further strikes on Saudi oil facilities and airports.

subject: ai_capex,ai_chips,f_semis
text: TSMC Q3 net profit jumps 69% to record T$763.1 billion, beating estimates. TSMC reported July-September net profit of T$763.1 billion, up about 69% year on year and above the T$746.3 billion LSEG SmartEstimate; revenue rose about 50% to T$1.49 trillion on AI chip demand. The result lands during a sharp global chip-stock selloff.

subject: ai_capex,f_semis
text: ASML posts record €11.7 billion quarterly sales on AI chip demand. ASML reported record quarterly sales of €11.7 billion, citing surging AI-related chip demand.

subject: dram,memory
text: Micron Taiwan union strike threat: President Lai urges both sides to negotiate sincerely. Taiwan's president called on Micron and its Taiwan unions to negotiate sincerely ahead of a possible strike; the Taoyuan union won 99% strike authorisation earlier in October over a bonus dispute and plans an October 19 rally.

subject: copper,copper_miners,f_copper
text: Copper falls for a third day as hot US CPI hits metals; ICSG sees refined surplus widening in 2027. Copper fell for a third straight session after strong US inflation data lifted rate-hike bets, and the ICSG, meeting in Lisbon this week, said it expects the global refined copper surplus to widen in 2027.

subject: aluminium,alu_producers
text: SHFE aluminium falls 1.78% to a fresh stage low. The most-traded Shanghai aluminium contract closed the midday session down 1.78%, hitting a new stage low, as China social inventories and rate-hike worries weighed.

subject: jet_fuel,brent,airlines
text: IEA: oil supply rebound remains fragile and diesel tightness persists. The IEA's October oil market report said the recovery in oil supply remains fragile and global diesel markets stay tight; the agency had already asked members to speed strategic stock releases with diesel prioritised, with its governing board meeting on 15 October.

subject: urea,sulphur,fertilizer
text: UN official warns failure to activate Hormuz fertiliser plan could trigger food crisis. A UN official said that failure to activate the planned mechanism for fertiliser and raw materials (urea, ammonia, sulphur) to pass the Strait of Hormuz could trigger a food crisis.

subject: freight,jpy
text: Japan cabinet approves three bills to fund Hormuz-bypass crude routes and tanker insurance backstop. Japan's cabinet approved bills to compensate importers for higher costs on routes bypassing Hormuz, let the state cover tanker insurance if reinsurers withdraw, and allow JOGMEC to invest in bypass pipelines; Japan sourced 94% of 2025 crude imports from the Middle East.

subject: jet_fuel
text: Fatal explosion at Motor Oil's Corinth refinery in Greece; workers strike. An explosion during maintenance at Motor Oil's Agioi Theodoroi refinery killed one contractor worker and seriously injured another; the company said the refinery kept operating, and workers went on strike after the accident.

subject: oil_majors
text: TotalEnergies flags Q3 profit surge as Iran war keeps energy prices high. TotalEnergies said in its third-quarter trading update that results would be lifted by high energy prices tied to the Iran war.

subject: fed_hike,us_yields
text: Citi expects a 25bp Fed rate hike in December after hot US CPI. Citi said it now expects the Federal Reserve to raise rates by 25 basis points in December following the hotter-than-expected September CPI.

subject: inflation
text: French harmonised inflation rises to 3.4% in September, highest since January 2024. France's EU-harmonised inflation rate rose to 3.4% in September from 2.6% in August, driven by energy and fresh food; the national CPI was 3.0%.

subject: inr,f_india
text: India bond market prices more RBI hikes; HSBC raises call to repo at 6% by December. Indian bond markets show bets building for further RBI rate hikes, and HSBC raised its forecast to see the repo rate at 6% by December, from 5.50% after October's hike.

subject: us_tariffs,inr,indian_it,f_india
text: Trump may decide in about 10 days on up to 100% tariffs on India over Russian oil. A US sanctions law signed 18 September gives the president power to impose tariffs of up to 100% on Indian exports tied to Russian oil purchases, with a decision point around 18 October.

subject: indian_it
text: Nifty IT index rallies about 11% in five sessions on rotation out of AI trade. India's Nifty IT index rose about 11% in five sessions as investors rotated from AI hardware into traditional IT services firms; TCS, HCL Tech and peers added about Rs 82,500 crore in three days.

subject: crypto_reg,crypto_stocks
text: White House crypto aide Patrick Witt departs as CLARITY Act stalls. Patrick Witt left the White House digital assets council while the CLARITY Act market-structure bill remains stalled in Congress.

subject: lng_export
text: Taiwan plans to invest $4.4 billion in Alaska LNG, subject to negotiations. Taiwan said it plans to invest $4.4 billion in the Alaska LNG project, subject to negotiations, after Trump said it would buy 30% of output.

subject: autos
text: Mexico removes 10% tariff on auto parts for five years. Mexico removed its 10% tariff on imported auto parts for a five-year period.

subject: steel_cos
text: US Steel workers rally in Gary in contract fight. United Steelworkers members rallied in Gary, Indiana, escalating a contract dispute with U.S. Steel.

subject: brent,oil_majors
text: Oil prices fall as traders weigh Gulf supply recovery against Hormuz attacks. WSJ reports crude lower on 15 Oct as recovering Gulf exports outweigh fresh Hormuz attacks; Energy Now reported Brent slipping below $100 to about $98.6 earlier in the week, with Gulf crude exports near 91% of pre-war levels per Vortexa.

subject: us_yields,f_bonds
text: Treasury and eurozone bond yields fall to multiweek lows as US inflation shock fades. WSJ and CNBC report US Treasury and eurozone yields falling to multiweek lows on 15 Oct as the hot September CPI shock fades and a tech sell-off fuels safe-haven demand.

subject: ai_chips,memory,f_semis
text: Nvidia, AMD and Micron fall as AI chip sell-off deepens. CNBC reports Nvidia, AMD and Micron shares falling as the AI-stock sell-off deepens on AI funding and data-centre debt worries, alongside the Asian tech rout.

subject: f_india,indian_it
text: Sensex surges about 1,500 points, Nifty reclaims 23,000 led by IT and banks. Indian benchmarks rallied on 15 Oct: Sensex up roughly 1,500 points and Nifty above 23,000, led by IT and banks, with falling oil prices and the Reliance Jio IPO cited as drivers despite the global tech sell-off.

subject: inr
text: RBI has spent about half of $140 billion FX capital haul defending the rupee, bankers estimate. Moneycontrol reports bankers estimate the RBI has used roughly half of a $140 billion foreign-exchange capital haul to defend the rupee near 95 per dollar.

subject: ttf
text: Equinor halts Troll gas field modification, boosting output. Reuters reports Equinor has halted a modification project at Norway's Troll gas field, Europe's largest, which lifts available gas output.

subject: china_controls,rare_earths
text: China indicates rare earths will keep flowing to EU regardless of US trade deal expiry. CNBC reports China signalled rare-earth exports to the EU will continue even as the one-year US-China export-control suspension nears expiry; the EU sources nearly 99% of its rare earths from China.

subject: nickel
text: Antaike: global nickel supply to see first annual decline since 2015 in 2026. China's Antaike says global nickel supply will fall in 2026 for the first time since 2015, consistent with INSG forecasts of a decline driven by Indonesia's ore quota cuts.

subject: copper,copper_miners
text: Antofagasta copper output rises 7%; miner sets 2027 guidance and lifts cost forecast. Antofagasta reported a 7% rise in copper output in its quarterly update, issued 2027 guidance and raised its cost forecast.

subject: tankers,freight
text: Tanker stocks plunge across Asia as US weighs easing shadow fleet sanctions. Lloyd's List reports tanker shipping shares fell sharply across Asia on 15 Oct after reports the US is weighing easing sanctions on shadow-fleet tankers to cut record freight rates.

subject: freight
text: Romania says eight people missing after fire on tanker in Black Sea. Romanian authorities say eight people are missing after a fire on a tanker in the Black Sea, the latest in a series of vessel incidents off Romania's coast.

subject: us_tariffs,inr
text: Sergio Gor says 'big items are done' on India-US trade deal amid 100% tariff threat. US Ambassador Sergio Gor said the major items of an India-US trade deal are done, even as Trump weighs up to 100% tariffs on India over Russian oil purchases.

subject: inflation,fed_hike
text: Fed: US labour market stuck in low-hire, low-fire state as inflation intensifies. A Federal Reserve report, as covered by the Economic Times, describes the US labour market as stuck in a low-hire, low-fire state while inflation pressures intensify.

subject: import_rules,silver
text: India notifies seven new BIS standards and launches silver refinery certification scheme. India rolled out seven new Bureau of Indian Standards norms covering EVs, robotics and healthcare, and launched a certification scheme for silver refineries.

subject: weather,rice
text: Southwest monsoon withdraws from all of India after weakest season since 2015. IMD says the southwest monsoon has withdrawn from the entire country; industry groups note it was the weakest monsoon since 2015, raising risks for the rabi crop.

subject: gulf_war,brent
text: Saudi-led coalition intercepts missile over Medina region; Houthis deny targeting the city. The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted and destroyed a cruise missile over the Medina region on 15 Oct, two days after the Houthi strike on Aramco's Dhahran headquarters; the Houthis denied targeting the holy city.

subject: freight,container
text: Container ship sinks in the Strait of Hormuz. Rigzone reported a container ship sank in the Strait of Hormuz on 15 Oct; Al Jazeera footage showed containers and debris floating in the strait. Corrected 15 Oct: the Singapore-flagged GFS Pride was hit on 13 Oct and sank by 14 Oct; all 21 crew evacuated (Marine Insight, CNN, Bloomberg).

subject: brent
text: API reports an 11.12 million barrel draw in US crude inventories. The American Petroleum Institute's weekly estimate showed US commercial crude stocks fell by about 11.12 million barrels, a sharp draw.

subject: lpg
text: Russia weighs LPG export ban for non-producers until year-end. Russia is considering banning LPG exports by non-producing traders through the end of 2026, alongside its existing gasoline export ban, as Ukrainian refinery strikes resume.

subject: lithium,lithium_miners
text: Lithium extends deep slump as battery demand concerns mount. Bloomberg reported lithium prices extending a deep slide on 15 Oct on worries about battery demand.

subject: sanctions
text: EU's 22nd sanctions package blacklists 23 Russian shipyards and repair plants. The EU's 22nd package, adopted 12 Oct, lists 23 Russian shipyards and ship-repair plants (many USC subsidiaries such as Admiralty and Sevmash) among roughly 1,600 defence-industry entities and individuals.

subject: devices,dram
text: Smartphone sales fall as chip costs soar; Counterpoint sees Q3 sales down 20%. Counterpoint data show Q3 2026 global smartphone sales fell about 20% year on year to a 14-year low, with average prices up about 20% as memory and processor costs surge on AI demand.

subject: gold
text: India's gold imports fall over 27% after import duty hike. India's gold imports declined more than 27% following the May increase in effective import duty from 6% to 15%.

subject: inflation,consumer
text: US toy prices surge ahead of holidays as tariffs and Iran war bite. Reuters reports US toy prices rising sharply ahead of the holiday season, citing tariffs and higher shipping and energy costs tied to the Iran war.

subject: fed_hike,us_yields
text: UBS adds a March Fed rate hike to its forecast after hot CPI. UBS extended its Fed tightening forecast to include a March hike after September CPI came in at about 3.7%.

subject: indian_it
text: Wipro Q2 net profit falls 2% to ₹3,201 crore; revenue up 9%. Wipro reported Q2 FY27 net profit down 2% year on year at ₹3,201 crore while revenue rose 9%.

subject: em_fx
text: Asian currencies slide as hot US inflation fuels Fed hike bets; won at two-week low. Asian currencies weakened on 15 Oct as hotter US CPI lifted Fed rate-hike bets, with the Korean won hitting a two-week low amid the Kospi crash.

subject: inr
text: Lenders flag freeze in rupee forwards and market distortions to RBI. Banks told the RBI that rupee forward markets have frozen and are distorted after recent hedging curbs, Bloomberg and Reuters reported.

subject: inr
text: RBI raises daily CRR maintenance requirement to 99% from 16 October. The RBI raised the share of the cash reserve ratio banks must maintain daily to 99% from 16 Oct, tightening rupee liquidity.

subject: beverages,import_rules
text: PepsiCo warns of energy drink shortage in India as label ban continues. PepsiCo warned of an energy drink shortage in India while a labelling ban remains in force.

subject: soybeans
text: USDA raises US corn and soybean yield estimates again. Agweek reports USDA surprised the market with higher corn and soybean yield estimates; Chicago corn and soybeans declined.

subject: gulf_war
text: Iran reportedly tells Hezbollah to 'prepare for war'. Israel Hayom reported Iran sent a message to Hezbollah to prepare for war.

subject: gulf_war,brent
text: US reportedly weighs 'mother of all bombs' as Iran insists Hormuz is closed. CNBC, citing a CNN report, said US Iran war plans include the GBU-43 'mother of all bombs' as Iran vowed to fight on and insisted Hormuz is closed, while Trump said the war will end 'very soon'.

subject: autos
text: India's Q2 automobile sales jump 18.2% to 83.88 lakh units. India's July-September vehicle sales rose 18.2% to 83.88 lakh units, helped by GST 2.0 rate cuts and capex.

subject: inflation,fed_hike,us_yields
text: US September PPI jumps 6.3% y/y, biggest annual gain since 2022. US producer prices rose 1.3% m/m and 6.3% y/y in September (from 5.6% in August), versus about 0.6% and 5.5% expected; energy from the Middle East conflict drove the jump. Core PPI ex food, energy and trade rose 0.5% m/m and 5% y/y.

subject: memory,dram
text: Memory stocks routed: SK Hynix down 26%, Samsung 22%, Micron 11% in five days on China CXMT and 2029 oversupply fears. CNBC reports SK Hynix fell about 26%, Samsung about 22% and Micron about 11% over five sessions after China's CXMT unveiled a denser 4F-squared server memory design and a Korean column flagged possible memory oversupply in 2029. Elon Musk separately called memory pricing 'extortio

subject: f_semis
text: Second worker dies after gas explosion at Intel's Kiryat Gat chip plant in Israel. A suspected gas cylinder malfunction during a material transfer at Intel's Kiryat Gat site (Fab 28) killed two workers and seriously injured a third; the fire involved nitrogen trifluoride used to clean chip tools. No production impact has been disclosed.

subject: china_controls,rare_earths
text: EU seeks sanctions swap with China to save rare-earth-dependent ASML supplier. The EU is negotiating to delist an unnamed Chinese firm from its Russia sanctions in exchange for China lifting sanctions on Sindlhauser Materials, a German ASML supplier fully reliant on Chinese rare earths that could shut within months. The two sides also discussed early warning of future export restrictions.

subject: nickel
text: INSG flips nickel outlook to surplus: 19 kt in 2026, widening to 70 kt in 2027. The International Nickel Study Group now sees a 19,000 t surplus in 2026 versus a 32,000 t deficit forecast in April, widening to 70,000 t in 2027, after raising its production forecast by 153,000 t and consumption by 102,000 t.

subject: f_semis
text: US to lift GlobalFoundries stake to about 5%; $21 billion Japan-funded fabs planned in New York. The Commerce Department will take about 4% more of GlobalFoundries (to roughly 5%) linked to a reallocated $955 million CHIPS award, and a US-Japan vehicle will fund two fabs in Malta, New York with $21 billion of Japanese capital, targeting operations from 2029.

subject: f_india
text: Yes Bank shares slump after Supreme Court upholds quashing of ₹8,415 crore AT-1 write-off. India's Supreme Court upheld the Bombay High Court order cancelling Yes Bank's 2020 write-off of ₹8,415 crore of AT-1 bonds, leaving the bank liable to bondholders plus interest. The stock fell as much as about 20% intraday to ₹16.96 and closed near ₹18.12.

subject: import_rules,soybeans
text: India customs scrutiny of 'Niger-origin' soybeans diverts cargoes to other Asian buyers at discounts. Indian customs is probing about 404,000 t of soybeans declared as Niger-origin this year (zero a year earlier), suspected to be Nigerian beans avoiding the 45% duty; about 60 containers are held at JNPT and Reuters reports cargoes are being diverted elsewhere in Asia at steep discounts.

subject: election_reform,oil_majors
text: Flavio Bolsonaro's Brazil election lead raises odds of Petrobras asset sales. Flavio Bolsonaro holds a narrow poll lead over Lula ahead of the 25 October runoff, and Bloomberg says this raises the prospect of sweeping Petrobras divestments, though he has publicly denied privatisation plans.

subject: brent,jet_fuel,oil_majors
text: IEA agrees to release outstanding 100 million barrels of emergency oil; total release to exceed 400 million. The IEA agreed to release the outstanding 100 million barrels of member oil stocks, taking its total coordinated release above 400 million barrels; the US separately told IEA nations it is unhappy with the release.

subject: russia_war,jet_fuel,brent
text: Ukraine hits Russian oil refinery as it resumes strikes; oil rises. Russia accused Ukraine of attacking an oil refinery after Zelenskyy said strikes would resume, and Axios reported Ukraine hit a Russian refinery; WSJ said oil rose on the Russia strikes.

subject: ttf,eu_chem,lng_export
text: Europe's gas prices near 2022 high as Hormuz LNG flows remain limited. OilPrice.com reported European gas prices close to their highest since 2022 as LNG flows through the Strait of Hormuz remain limited.

subject: hh,f_gas
text: US natural gas futures extend rally after bullish storage print and TCO pipeline outage. NGI reported Henry Hub futures sustained a rally after a bullish weekly storage report, with a TCO pipeline outage also supporting prices.

subject: copper,copper_miners
text: No breakthrough in talks at Antofagasta's striking Centinela copper mine, unions say. Unions at Antofagasta's Centinela copper mine in Chile, on strike since 7 October, said talks produced no breakthrough.

subject: copper,copper_miners
text: BHP and Escondida union reach contract deal, averting copper mine strike. BHP reached a contract deal with a union at Escondida, the world's largest copper mine, averting a strike after government-mediated talks.

subject: copper
text: Mercuria delivers 12,000 tons of DRC copper to US Project Vault stockpile. Mercuria delivered 12,000 tons of copper from the Democratic Republic of Congo to the US Project Vault strategic stockpile.

subject: freight,tankers,gulf_war
text: Iran says oil tanker caught fire in Gulf of Oman. Iran said an oil tanker caught fire in the Gulf of Oman, adding to a run of vessel incidents near Hormuz.

subject: gulf_war,brent,defense
text: Saudi-led coalition says Houthis attempted to attack dozens of Saudi facilities. The Saudi-led coalition said the Houthis attempted to attack dozens of Saudi facilities, a day after Houthi fire was intercepted over the Medina region and following the strike on Aramco's Dhahran headquarters.

subject: brent
text: Saudi Aramco offers extra spot crude cargoes to Europe, sources say. Reuters reported, citing sources, that Saudi Aramco is offering extra spot crude cargoes to European buyers after cutting October term supply to the region.

subject: gold,silver
text: India gold losing streak deepens as rupee strengthens; silver sinks Rs 6,000 per kg. Gold extended its losing streak in India as a stronger rupee weighed, while silver fell by Rs 6,000 per kg.

subject: inr
text: RBI clarifies scope of forex curbs; banks must keep 20% FERR above CRR balance. The RBI clarified the scope of its forex hedging curbs after market swings and said banks must maintain the 20% FERR over and above their CRR balance.

subject: inr
text: India's August balance of payments swings to $45.4 billion surplus. India's balance of payments swung to a $45.4 billion surplus in August, Reuters reported.

subject: us_tariffs,palm_oil
text: US threatens sanctions on Spanish shipping and olive oil imports in trade dispute. Marine Insight reported the US is threatening sanctions on Spanish shipping and on olive oil imports amid a trade dispute.

subject: tankers,sanctions
text: Ship-to-ship oil transfers surge off India's west coast. OilPrice.com reported a surge in ship-to-ship oil transfers off India's west coast as sanctioned and rerouted crude flows adjust.

subject: crypto_reg,bitcoin
text: Russia to ban direct person-to-person crypto trades from July 2027. The Moscow Times reported Russia will ban direct person-to-person cryptocurrency trades from July 2027.

subject: bitcoin,ether,crypto_stocks
text: Bitcoin briefly dips below $80,000; Bitcoin and Ether ETFs lose $391 million in a day. Bloomberg reported Bitcoin briefly fell below $80,000 as volatility roiled markets, and 24/7 Wall St. reported $391 million of outflows from Bitcoin and Ether ETFs in a day.

subject: ai_capex
text: TSMC explores Texas investment to expand US production. Spectrum News reported TSMC is exploring an investment in Texas to expand its production in the United States, after reporting record quarterly profit.

subject: brent,f_oil
text: EIA: US crude stocks fall 8.6 million barrels, far more than expected. EIA data for the week to Oct 9 showed US crude inventories down 8.557 million barrels versus a forecast 0.3 million draw (prior -3.186 million); Cushing stocks rose 1.862 million barrels and crude imports fell 0.596 million b/d.

subject: jet_fuel,airlines
text: IEA to release more than 20 million barrels of diesel as soon as possible. The IEA Governing Board agreed to speed up the remaining ~100 million barrels of its March collective action, including over 20 million barrels of diesel as soon as possible; about 330 million of the pledged 400 million barrels have been released. The diesel figure is below the 50 million barrels discussed earlier.

subject: sanctions
text: US issues fresh Iran-related sanctions. The US Treasury website showed new Iran-related sanctions designations on Oct 15, adding to pressure on Iranian trade networks during the Gulf conflict.

subject: sanctions,tankers
text: UK tightens Russian oil sanctions as US weighs relief. Britain tightened sanctions on Russian oil shipping on Oct 15 even as Washington considers easing shadow-fleet sanctions, widening the transatlantic split on Russian crude.

subject: wheat,import_rules
text: Egypt tightens wheat import requirements as Black Sea supplies shrink. Egypt, which has relied on Russia and Ukraine for most of its wheat imports, tightened its wheat import requirements as Black Sea supply shrinks amid attacks on shipping.

subject: copper,copper_miners
text: Teck Highland Valley Copper workers to vote on strike mandate. Unionized workers at Teck's Highland Valley Copper mine in Logan Lake, British Columbia, Canada's largest copper mine, are to vote on a strike mandate.

subject: memory
text: SK Hynix seeks chip-tool exports to its China fab in return for building a US factory. SK Hynix is bargaining with Washington for continued chip equipment exports to its China facility in exchange for building a factory in the US.

subject: soybeans
text: US soybeans hit seven-week low as Brazil sees big crops. US soybean futures fell to a seven-week low despite renewed Chinese purchases, as harvest pressure and fund selling weighed; Brazil's CONAB projects sizable soybean and corn crops for 2026/27.

subject: gold,gold_miners
text: Gold rebounds on weaker dollar and lower yields. Gold rebounded as the dollar retreated from an 18-month high and Treasury yields fell, with October Fed hike bets subdued.

subject: gulf_war,red_sea
text: Houthi missile hits Yemeni presidential palace, killing two. A Houthi missile attack on the Yemeni presidential palace killed two people, a minister said, while a besieged Yemeni city runs low on food and fuel as Houthi forces press an offensive.

subject: defense
text: North Korea tests first submarine-launched cruise missile in nearly 3 years. North Korea test-fired a submarine-launched cruise missile, its first such test in nearly three years.

subject: homebuilders
text: US mortgage rates fall sharply despite hot PPI. US mortgage rates dropped as Treasury yields slid to multiweek lows, even after September PPI rose 6.3% y/y.

subject: em_fx,ttf

subject: container,freight
text: Hurricane Trudy brings hurricane warning to Manzanillo, Mexico's busiest container port. NHC advisory 17 put Hurricane Trudy 170 miles south of Manzanillo with 90 mph winds, moving NW at 10 mph, with a hurricane warning from Manzanillo to Cabo Corrientes and 4 to 8 inches of rain (up to 12) for Michoacan, Colima and Jalisco.

subject: import_rules
text: India-New Zealand FTA tariff cuts take effect October 20. Livemint reports the India-New Zealand free trade agreement's first tariff cuts start on October 20, with sheep meat at zero duty and kiwifruit at 15%; about 57% of New Zealand exports to India, including wool and coal, become tariff-free from day one, while India keeps dairy, sugar and edible oils off its concession list.

subject: russia_war
text: Ukraine denies Russian claim of capturing 1,800 sq km and 92 settlements since September 1. Ukraine's general staff rejected Russia's claim to have taken more than 1,800 sq km and 92 settlements since September 1, and said the town of Dobropillia remains under Ukrainian control.

subject: container,freight
text: Hurricane Trudy strengthens to 100 mph as it nears Manzanillo port. NHC advisory 18 (2100 UTC) put Trudy 115 miles SSW of Manzanillo with 100 mph winds after Hurricane Hunters found it stronger than estimated; hurricane conditions are expected from Manzanillo to Cabo Corrientes tonight, with the centre passing near the coast tonight and Sunday.

subject: ttf,lng_export
text: NYT: US floats allowing more Russian gas sales to Europe. The New York Times reports the US is floating a step that would allow more Russian gas sales to Europe, a day after Trump waived sanctions and duties under the Graham Act; the EU plans to end Russian gas imports by end-2027.

subject: dram,devices
text: Apple CEO Ternus calls memory shortage a crisis, says all options on the table. In his first in-depth interview as CEO, John Ternus called the AI-driven DRAM shortage a crisis and said all options should be on the table; Apple already raised Mac and iPad prices in June on memory costs.

subject: crypto_reg
text: French Assembly backs tax on crypto-to-stablecoin swaps by one vote. The Defiant reports France's National Assembly backed, by one vote, a measure making swaps of crypto into euro- or dollar-pegged stablecoins taxable from January 2027; the finance committee had earlier approved and then dropped the amendment with the revenue section.

subject: gulf_war,freight
text: Saudi-led coalition intercepts two Houthi ballistic missiles fired toward Khamis Mushait and a drone over Riyadh. The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted and destroyed two Houthi ballistic missiles launched toward Khamis Mushait, and later a drone in the Riyadh region, after civil defence alerts for Abha and Khamis Mushait earlier on Saturday.

subject: autos
text: Unifor members at Stellantis Canada begin two-day strike authorization vote. About 9,000 Unifor members at Stellantis' Brampton, Windsor and Etobicoke plants vote Oct 17-18 on a strike mandate, with results due Oct 19, after talks stalled over the idled Brampton plant; the previous contract expired Sept 20.

subject: consumer,inflation
text: Cost-of-living protests spread to Belgium, Italy and Portugal alongside France. Protests over rising living costs driven by energy prices hit Belgium, Italy, Portugal and France on Saturday, a day after large and partly violent demonstrations in Paris and Lyon.

subject: ttf,lng_export
text: Woodside natural gas project unit paused after Greenpeace protest off Western Australia. Reuters reports Woodside paused a unit at one of its natural gas projects off Western Australia after a Greenpeace protest. Duration and which facility were not confirmed by search.

subject: tankers,freight
text: Kpler says US sanctions relief is unlikely to ease the tanker crisis. Kpler says easing US sanctions on shadow-fleet tankers would add little usable capacity: about 160 sanctioned supertankers (22% of the fleet), of which only about 24 could realistically return. Rates are driven by Hormuz attacks and war-risk insurance.

subject: brent
text: Venezuela expects nearly $76 billion in oil investment over five years, acting president says. Reuters reports that Venezuela's acting president expects nearly $76 billion of oil investment over five years. Search did not surface the figure separately.

subject: sanctions,ttf
text: Rubio says Trump's Russia sanctions waiver is a 60-day pause to analyse economic impact. Secretary of State Rubio described the waiver of new Russia sanctions and energy-linked duties under the Graham Act as a 60-day pause to assess the economic impact, The Guardian reports. Search did not confirm the 60-day framing.

subject: russia_war,airlines
text: Lithuania issues red air-raid alert, shuts Kaunas airport as NATO jets scramble over possible drones. Lithuania's crisis centre issued a red air-raid alert for central and northern regions and urged residents to shelter; NATO air police were scrambled and Kaunas airport was shut. Latvia issued a yellow alert for southern regions near Lithuania over a possible drone threat.

subject: gulf_war,freight
text: UKMTO: tug hit by two unidentified projectiles northeast of Khor Fakkan, UAE. UKMTO said a southbound tug reported being hit by two unidentified projectiles northeast of Khor Fakkan, UAE; the tug was damaged but continued on its course.

subject: russia_war,jet_fuel
text: Ukrainian drone swarm attacks St Petersburg; oil terminal reported burning. Al Jazeera reported St Petersburg under attack from a Ukrainian drone swarm overnight, and REFORM.news reported an oil terminal burning in the city with a VK data centre also reportedly hit; Russian officials had not confirmed damage at the time of these reports.

subject: em_fx,memory
text: Korean won climbs to a two-year high as chip exports boost dollar supply. The won rose to its strongest level in about two years as exporters converted chip earnings; September chip exports hit a record $60.3 billion (+263% y/y) and the won had already reached 1,335.1 per dollar on Oct 12.

subject: f_india
text: YES Bank Q2 profit rises 65%, but an AT1 ruling could mean a ₹5,217 crore loss. YES Bank reported a 65% rise in Q2 FY27 net profit, while flagging that an adverse outcome on its written-off AT1 bonds could cost it ₹5,217 crore.

subject: inr,f_india
text: Foreign portfolio investors pull ₹52,100 crore from Indian equities in October so far. The Economic Times reported FPIs have withdrawn about ₹52,100 crore from Indian equities so far in October amid global headwinds; NSDL data cited by Angel One showed ₹47,417 crore through October 12, with 2026 outflows above ₹3 lakh crore.

subject: f_india
text: Record ₹30,213 crore Jio Platforms IPO opens October 21 among ₹31,663 crore of offerings this week. Jio Platforms' IPO (price band ₹1,065-1,119, about ₹30,213 crore at the top, India's largest) takes anchor bids on October 19 and opens October 21-23; nine listings worth ₹31,663 crore are lined up this week.

subject: russia_war,brent,jet_fuel
text: Ukraine launches more than 1,000 drones at Russia, setting St Petersburg oil terminal and depot ablaze. Russia's defence ministry said it downed about 1,015 Ukrainian drones overnight, one of the largest attacks of the war; fires hit the St Petersburg oil terminal, the Ruchyi oil depot and a VK data centre, with one person killed. Russia answered with about 300 drones.

subject: gulf_war,freight,tankers
text: IRGC navy says another oil tanker exploded after hitting a mine in the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian media cited the IRGC navy saying an oil tanker caught fire and blasted after striking a mine in the Strait of Hormuz; no vessel name or independent confirmation was given.

subject: gulf_war,brent
text: Trump endorses Netanyahu and warns the US could soon 'finish the job' against Iran. In a Truth Social post nine days before Israel's Oct 27 election, Trump endorsed Netanyahu and said that unless Iran changes course quickly the US would soon finish the job; Araghchi replied Iran has unfinished jobs too.

subject: gulf_war,brent
text: Araghchi says Iran's seven-day plan still stands and Hormuz could reopen Friday if the US accepts. Iran's foreign minister said the conditional plan, which asks for about $12 billion in frozen assets, oil-sanction relief and an end to the US naval blockade, could reopen Hormuz on day six; Trump earlier called the terms not acceptable.

subject: risk_on,consumer
text: France cost-of-living riots: about 2,400 arrested and nearly 1,000 police injured. Interior Minister Nunez said about 2,400 people were arrested and close to 1,000 officers hurt on Oct 17 as more than 550,000 marched; Limoges town hall was torched and 50 Carrefour stores damaged, with fresh clashes in Paris and Marseille on Oct 18.

subject: us_tariffs
text: US ambassador warns EU of 'devastating' retaliation if Brussels curbs Starlink spectrum access. US envoy Andrew Puzder told the FT that European firms could face severe retaliation in the US if the EU reserves part of the satellite-to-phone spectrum for European operators; he also criticised the Cloud and AI Development Act and DMA fines.

subject: russia_war,freight
text: Romanian F-16s shoot down two drones over the Black Sea; NATO council to meet Tuesday. Romania's defence minister said F-16s downed two drones about 20 km southeast of Sulina on Oct 17 at 14:59 and 15:05 GMT; the issue goes to the North Atlantic Council on Tuesday after drone strikes on two chemical tankers off Romania that week.

subject: freight,wheat
text: Russian defence ministry says it hit a cargo ship near Ukraine's Odesa. Russia's defence ministry said its forces struck a cargo ship near Odesa; no vessel details were given.

subject: gulf_war,red_sea
text: Saudi civil defence says six injured after a projectile lands in Najran. Saudi civil defence said six people were injured when a projectile landed in Najran near the Yemen border, as GCC states condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia.

subject: memory,ai_chips
text: Samsung to use TSMC 3nm base dies for Nvidia's next-generation custom HBM, Seoul paper reports. Reuters, citing the Seoul Economic Daily, said Samsung accepted Nvidia's request to use TSMC's 3nm process for NVHBM base dies and sixth-generation DRAM for core dies; Nvidia reportedly asked SK Hynix and Micron to do the same. No company confirmed it.

subject: ai_capex,hyperscalers
text: Microsoft pulls out of Nscale's Loughton UK data centre deal, Telegraph reports. Microsoft terminated its anchor-tenant agreement for Nscale's planned Loughton, Essex site, the Telegraph reported; grid officials had said power may not arrive until the 2030s. Nscale, preparing an IPO of up to $3 billion, said it remains committed.

subject: rare_earths,re_miners
text: Shenghe Resources plans to sell 51% stakes in four rare-earth units to China Rare Earth Group. Shenghe Resources announced a plan to bring a China Rare Earth Group unit into 51% stakes of Leshan Shenghe and three other smelting and separation subsidiaries for a projected 1.66 to 1.81 billion yuan, further consolidating China's rare-earth processing under the state group.

subject: copper,risk_on,steel
text: China Q3 GDP grows 4.5%, beating forecasts; September retail sales up 1.1%. China's GDP grew 4.5% y/y in Q3 (poll 4.4%, Q2 4.3%) and 1.2% q/q; September retail sales rose 1.1% (poll 0.5%) and industrial output 5.5%, while Jan-Sep fixed-asset investment fell 7.2% and property investment 20.6%.

subject: risk_on
text: China moves to prop up stocks with selling curbs and state buying after 10% slide, Bloomberg reports. Regulators asked companies and state-backed funds to buy shares, guided some investors to reduce selling and told major insurers not to lock in losses, after the benchmark fell about 10% this year to its lowest since August 2025.

subject: f_semis,ai_chips,em_fx
text: Taiwan stocks open down more than 860 points after SOX falls 3.83%; central bank blames foreign selling for Taiwan dollar decline. Taiwan's index opened down over 860 points to test 46,200 after the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 3.83%; Taiwan's central bank said the Taiwan dollar's recent decline mainly reflects foreign investors net selling Taiwan stocks and repatriating funds, and it wil

subject: brent,jet_fuel
text: Brent dips about 2% to $108 after US waives Russia oil sanctions. Crude fell about 2% to around $108 a barrel early Monday after hitting its highest level since May, as the US pause on Russia sanctions raised expectations of more Russian supply; WTI slipped to near $97.50.

subject: sanctions,jet_fuel
text: Trump defends Russia sanctions pause, says Zelensky's refinery strikes are hurting US diesel markets. Trump defended the waiver of Russia sanctions and tariffs, saying it keeps Moscow at the negotiating table and that Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries are pushing up US diesel costs; the UK said it disagrees with the move.

subject: russia_war
text: Putin suggests meeting with Trump and Xi to discuss ending the Ukraine war, report says. Putin suggested a three-way meeting with Trump and Xi to discuss a resolution of the Ukraine war, the Jerusalem Post reported; the Kremlin earlier said such talks could happen at the APEC summit in Shenzhen on Nov 18-19.

subject: russia_war
text: Russian strike kills a woman and hits a Kyiv subway station, mayor says. A Russian overnight strike on Kyiv killed a woman and damaged a metro station, the city's mayor said, Reuters reported.

subject: memory
text: China's CXMT shares drop over 6% as investors look past profit turnaround. Shares of Chinese memory maker CXMT fell more than 6% on Monday despite its swing to profit on surging memory prices, extending volatility in memory stocks.

subject: ai_capex
text: NextDC flags earnings risk from power delay at Melbourne data centre. Australian data centre operator NextDC warned that a delay in power supply to its Melbourne campus poses a risk to earnings, Bloomberg reported.

subject: freight
text: Hurricane Trudy weakens rapidly to 80 mph and moves away from Mexico; no coastal warnings remain. NHC advisory 23 put Trudy 220 miles WNW of Manzanillo with 80 mph winds, weakening rapidly and moving northwest at 7 mph away from mainland Mexico; no coastal watches or warnings are in effect.

subject: pandemic
text: Kenya confirms eighth Ebola case amid widening regional outbreak. Kenya confirmed an eighth Ebola case, up from seven reported on Oct 17, as the outbreak that began with a patient from DR Congo widens in the region.

subject: lpg,sanctions
text: Pakistan suspends border trade with Iran, leaving hundreds of freight vehicles stranded. Pakistan suspended border trade with Iran and hundreds of freight vehicles were left stranded, India Today reported, a day after an official said banking sanctions had halted Iran's exports to Pakistan.

subject: jpy,jp_exporters
text: BOJ's Ueda says underlying inflation is 'quite close' to the 2% goal. Bank of Japan Governor Ueda said underlying inflation is near the 2% target, citing Middle East energy costs and AI-driven demand, and said long-term rates are likely to rise steadily if the bank raises its policy rate; dollar/yen eased 0.19% to 157.72.

subject: jet_fuel
text: China's September fuel exports jump 39.4%. China's refined fuel exports rose 39.4% in September, Oil & Gas Middle East reported, adding product supply as Brent touched $110 amid Hormuz tanker mine strikes.

subject: helium,ai_chips
text: 60 Minutes: helium spot prices triple as Iran war disrupts supply. CBS 60 Minutes reported helium is in short supply as the Iran war continues, with spot prices tripling; Qatar's Ras Laffan, a major helium source, was damaged earlier in the war and most of its exports pass through Hormuz.

subject: steel,steel_cos
text: China's daily crude steel output jumps in September on robust exports. China's average daily crude steel output rose in September as strong exports supported mills, Reuters reported via TradingView, though mill profits slipped.

subject: rice,weather
text: Monsoon deficit puts India's rice and maize output at risk. India's 2026 monsoon ended about 12.6% below normal, the weakest since 2015, with south peninsular rainfall about 24% short; a report warned of risks to rice and maize production and supply chains as southern states brace for drought.

subject: coffee,coffee_chains
text: Vietnam coffee output seen flat as El Niño threatens next crop. Vietnam's robusta coffee output is forecast roughly flat, with the industry association warning that El Niño threatens the following crop in the Central Highlands.

subject: india_omc,jet_fuel
text: Indian refineries ship $1.2 billion of fuel to the West, up 43%. Indian refiners' fuel exports to Western markets rose 43% to about $1.2 billion, Times Now reported, as Europe and the US seek diesel and jet fuel amid Russia and Gulf disruptions.

subject: china_controls,rare_earths
text: China commerce ministry says dual-use items export-control announcement takes effect November 18. China's Ministry of Commerce announced further work on optimising export-control concerns and identification for dual-use items, with the announcement taking effect on November 18. Full scope was not detailed in the first wire headlines.

subject: aluminium,alu_producers
text: China aluminium output hits record quarterly high despite capacity cap. China's primary aluminium output reached a record quarterly high in Q3 2026 despite the 45 million tonne capacity ceiling, after August set a monthly record of 3.98 million tonnes.

subject: palm_oil,weather
text: Drought in Indonesia affects 13 palm oil mills. The Japan Times reports drought in Indonesia has affected 13 palm oil mills, as El Niño brings low rainfall to key oil palm regions.

subject: usd,em_fx
text: China's yuan hits four-year high as strong GDP data ease stimulus concerns. The yuan rose to a four-year high against the dollar after China's Q3 GDP grew 4.5%, beating forecasts; the PBOC also set a stronger midpoint fixing.

subject: inr
text: Rupee rises to 94.80 per dollar on RBI intervention despite crude pressure. The Indian rupee gained about 22 paise to around 94.80 per dollar in early trade on central bank intervention, while high crude prices remained a threat to the recovery.

subject: us_tariffs,inr,f_india
text: Rubio says US-India trade deal is near finalisation. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the US and India are close to finalising their trade agreement; the published framework cuts additional US duties on Indian goods from 25% to 18%.

subject: copper_miners,copper
text: South32 maintains FY27 guidance after September-quarter copper output surge. South32's September 2026 quarterly report showed a surge in copper output and the miner kept its FY27 production guidance unchanged.

subject: memory
text: SK hynix launches 2 trillion won financing program for chip suppliers. SK hynix launched a 2 trillion won financing programme to support its semiconductor suppliers, the Korea Herald reports.

subject: ai_capex,ai_chips
text: GMO Internet to spend ¥26.1 billion on up to 116 Nvidia B300 servers. Japan's GMO Internet plans to spend ¥26.1 billion on up to 116 Nvidia B300 servers.

subject: ai_capex
text: Kazakhstan builds $5 billion AI data center hub in Ekibastuz. Kazakhstan is building a $5 billion AI data centre hub in Ekibastuz, Qazinform reports.

subject: ttf,jp_exporters
text: Japan power price hits four-year high on rising coal and LNG costs. Japanese wholesale power prices reached a four-year high as coal and LNG import costs rose.

subject: alu_producers,ai_capex
text: Alcoa to sell part of Massena East site for up to $315 million for data centre use. Alcoa agreed to sell a portion of its Massena East site in New York for up to $315 million as data centre plans emerge for the land.

subject: ether
text: Ethereum ETFs lose $320 million in a week as bitcoin outflows slow. US spot ether ETFs recorded about $320 million of net outflows over the past week while bitcoin ETF outflows slowed.

subject: crypto_reg
text: South Korea's FSS says new crypto oversight framework talks near completion. South Korea's FSS governor said talks with the Financial Intelligence Unit on a new crypto oversight framework are near completion, as regulators meet exchanges amid calls to delay crypto taxation.

subject: japan_fiscal,jpy
text: Japan PM Takaichi rejects criticism over weak yen and high bond yields. Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi rejected criticism that her policies are behind the weak yen and higher interest rates.

subject: memory
text: South Korea regulator says Solidigm US listing may breach dual-listing rules. A South Korean regulator said a planned US listing of SK hynix's Solidigm unit may breach dual-listing rules.

subject: f_india
text: Nifty slips below 23,000 as Axis Bank and HDFC Bank drag; PSU bank index rises 3%. The Sensex fell about 558 points and the Nifty slipped under 23,000 as Axis Bank fell up to 5% after Q2 results, while the Nifty PSU Bank index rose about 3% led by PNB.

subject: crypto_reg,bitcoin
text: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody in Germany, targets Asia in 2027. Deutsche Bank launched a crypto custody service in Germany and plans to expand it to Asia in 2027.

subject: copper
text: South Korea's LS MnM considers cutting copper processing capacity. LS MnM, South Korea's biggest copper smelter (about 600,000 t/yr of refined copper), is considering a cut to its copper processing capacity as smelter margins stay squeezed by very low treatment charges.

subject: tankers,freight,brent
text: Two more oil tankers hit mines crossing the Strait of Hormuz; Iran reports a third mine strike in three days. Marine Link reports two oil tankers hit mines while crossing the Strait of Hormuz, and Iranian media count a third tanker mine strike near Hormuz in three days.

subject: china_controls
text: China tightens export controls on solar-manufacturing tech, tunnel boring machines, dredgers and drones. China's commerce ministry announced licence requirements for exports of high-end equipment including tunnel boring machines, dredgers and drones, and proposed export controls on key solar-manufacturing technologies, reports say targeting India and the US.

subject: f_india,inr
text: Jio Platforms IPO anchor book draws about ₹2.5 lakh crore of demand, nearly 30 times the quota. The anchor portion of the record ₹30,213 crore Jio Platforms IPO drew about ₹2.5 lakh crore of bids (Reuters: nearly 30 times oversubscribed), with BlackRock, GIC and LIC among participants; public bidding runs October 21-23.

subject: usd,risk_on
text: Euro falls and European stocks drop as French unrest and high energy prices weigh. The euro slipped and the Stoxx index fell at the open as violent cost-of-living protests in France and high energy prices weighed on sentiment.

subject: risk_on
text: PBOC governor: overnight reverse repo may become policy rate; new liquidity tool for non-bank redemptions. PBOC Governor said China is weighing the overnight reverse repo rate as its policy rate, will launch a liquidity support tool for large-scale redemptions by non-bank institutions and will let more overseas institutions trade RMB in the onshore FX market.

subject: brent
text: Trafigura economist: Middle East crude flows down 5-7 million b/d versus pre-war level. Trafigura chief economist Saad Rahim said Middle East crude flows are 5m-7m barrels a day below pre-war levels.

subject: jet_fuel,russia_war
text: Zelensky offers to halt strikes on Russian refineries in exchange for more Patriot missiles. Zelensky said Ukraine could stop striking Russian refineries if it received more US Patriot interceptors, calling that the minimum acceptable; Ukraine resumed refinery strikes on October 15.

subject: russia_war
text: Massive overnight Russian attack leaves over half a million Ukrainians without power. Zelensky said a large overnight Russian missile and drone attack on energy infrastructure left more than 500,000 Ukrainians without electricity.

subject: autos
text: Mexico limits five-year auto parts tariff break to carmakers already producing in Mexico. Mexico's economy ministry said the zero-tariff scheme (cut from 10%) for SKD/CKD assembly kits applies only to automakers with production facilities in Mexico, 11 of which are eligible, after concern that Chinese newcomers could benefit.

subject: f_india
text: UltraTech Cement Q2 net profit up 21% to ₹1,494 crore; revenue up 19%. UltraTech Cement reported a 21% year-on-year rise in second-quarter net profit to ₹1,494 crore on revenue growth of 19%.

subject: f_india
text: Union Bank of India Q2 profit up 30%; shares jump 5%. Union Bank of India shares rose 5% after Q2 net profit rose 30% year on year with improved asset quality, as PSU banks bucked a broad Indian market fall.

subject: rice,weather
text: India trims foodgrain target as weak monsoon and El Niño squeeze kharif harvest. India cut its foodgrain production target as a deficient monsoon and El Niño hurt the kharif crop.

subject: us_yields,f_bonds
text: US Treasury yields move lower as investors assess the inflation backdrop. US Treasury yields fell on Monday as investors weighed the US inflation outlook and easing oil prices, with Fed hike fears receding.

subject: freight
text: Strike at the ports of Naples and Salerno puts goods and deliveries at risk. A strike at the Italian ports of Naples and Salerno is disrupting cargo handling and deliveries.

subject: ai_capex
text: Nebius shares fall amid AI funding fears. Shares of AI cloud provider Nebius fell as investors worried about funding for AI infrastructure build-outs.

subject: memory,risk_on
text: South Korea's President Lee says a stock correction is inevitable after a sharp rally. President Lee Jae-myung said a stock market correction is inevitable after the sharp rally and that it is difficult for the government to intervene.

subject: crypto_reg
text: Japanese banks complete joint stablecoin issuance. A group of Japanese banks completed a joint stablecoin issuance.

subject: crypto_reg
text: South Korea considers delaying crypto tax as five exchanges meet officials. South Korean officials are considering postponing the planned crypto tax after meeting the country's five main exchanges.

subject: bitcoin,crypto_stocks
text: MARA sends $82.8 million of bitcoin to exchanges. Bitcoin miner MARA moved about $82.8 million of bitcoin to exchanges in October, signalling possible sales.

subject: ttf
text: European gas prices rise even as oil retreats. European TTF gas prices rose on Monday while crude fell on the US waiver of Russia oil sanctions.

subject: nickel
text: India's NMDC puts overseas nickel foray on hold on global oversupply concerns. Reuters sources say state miner NMDC has delayed plans to develop overseas nickel mines and buy nickel assets because of global oversupply.

subject: brent,jet_fuel
text: Unite announces 24-hour strike by Apache North Sea workers, warns of UK fuel disruption. Unite says more than 160 Apache offshore workers on Forties-linked assets will strike for 24 hours; it warns the Forties Pipeline System (about 29% of UK oil) could be disrupted, while Apache says contingency plans should keep it running.

subject: red_sea,freight
text: Houthi attack on Yemeni government camp in Shabwa kills at least 18. Reuters sources say at least 18 were killed when the Houthis struck a Yemeni government military camp in Shabwa, as the Yemen war re-erupts.

subject: f_india,risk_on
text: Sensex falls 876 points to 73,852 and Nifty closes at 22,888 as banks and crude weigh. The Sensex closed down 876 points at 73,852 and the Nifty fell 257 points (1.1%) to 22,888, led by private banks such as Axis Bank and HDFC Bank, with weak earnings and high crude cited.

subject: ai_capex
text: AI chip startup Tenstorrent raises funds at a $6.2 billion valuation. Bloomberg reports Jim Keller's Tenstorrent raised new funding at a $6.2 billion valuation, up from about $2.6 billion in its December 2024 round.

subject: inr
text: India-New Zealand free trade agreement takes effect October 20. The India-New Zealand FTA comes into force on October 20, giving 100% of Indian exports duty-free access; India keeps dairy, sugar and several farm products out of its concessions.

subject: inflation
text: Bundesbank says German inflation risks are clearly tilted to the upside. The Bundesbank said risks to German inflation are clearly tilted to the upside, Bloomberg reports.

subject: em_fx
text: China to allow more brokerages into its onshore FX market, Xinhua says. Xinhua reports China will let more securities brokerages trade in the onshore foreign exchange market, widening participation as the yuan sits near a four-year high.

subject: steel_cos
text: JSW Steel gains 2.5% after Orissa High Court quashes ₹696 crore demand. JSW Steel rose 2.5% to top the Nifty gainers after the Orissa High Court quashed a ₹696 crore demand against the company.

subject: copper
text: Copper falls as LME stocks rise and mine supply concerns ease. LME copper fell on Monday as exchange inventories edged higher and concerns over mine supply eased.

subject: inflation
text: Bessent links September inflation to an "energy shock". Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent attributed September's inflation to an energy shock as US stock futures rose ahead of big tech earnings.

subject: inflation,brent
text: Canada's inflation rate rises to 3.1% in September on higher energy prices. Statistics Canada said annual CPI rose to 3.1% in September, driven by gasoline, while core measures eased (CPI-median 1.9% vs 2.0% prior). Bank of Canada Governor Macklem said inflation risks are rising as the oil shock lingers.

subject: hyperscalers,ai_capex
text: Pentagon's Emil Michael vows export controls if AI labs don't cooperate with government. The Information reported that Pentagon technology chief Emil Michael said export controls could follow if AI labs do not cooperate with the government. He also said current laws are sufficient for AI regulation.

subject: ai_chips,hyperscalers
text: Amazon opens AWS Trainium AI chips to all PyTorch developers. Amazon said it is opening its Trainium AI chips to all PyTorch developers and will open-source TorchNeuron at the PyTorch conference on October 20.

subject: bitcoin,crypto_stocks
text: Strategy buys 267 bitcoin at an average of about $82,900 in the week to October 18. Strategy (MSTR) bought 267 BTC at an average price of about $82.9k in the week ended October 18 and repurchased preferred shares, its weekly update showed.

subject: ether,crypto_stocks
text: Bitmine's ETH holdings reach 6.04 million tokens. Bitmine Immersion Technologies (BMNR) said its ether holdings reached 6.04 million tokens.

subject: f_india
text: Bajaj Finance Q2 net profit up 29% to ₹6,367 crore; NII up 24%. Bajaj Finance reported September-quarter net profit of ₹6,367 crore, up 29% year on year, with net interest income up 24%.

subject: inr,f_india
text: India bonds give up the day's gains as oil price spike adds to rate-hike fears. Indian government bonds erased early gains as higher crude prices revived concerns about an RBI rate hike.

subject: memory,dram
text: Micron rallies as a Chinese memory-chip rival forecasts a revenue boom. Barron's reported Micron shares rose after a Chinese memory chipmaker forecast sharply higher revenue, a sign of strong memory demand.

subject: ai_chips,f_semis
text: Chip stocks bounce after the longest losing streak since 2008. US semiconductor shares rebounded in premarket trade after the SOX index's longest losing streak since 2008, including a 3.83% fall on Friday.

subject: lpg,jet_fuel
text: Iranian LPG and jet fuel shipments pass through the US blockade. Shipments of Iranian LPG and jet fuel were reported passing through the US naval blockade.

subject: gulf_war,brent
text: Tehran seeks to punish Trump in the midterms with oil price pain, Iranian officials say. The Washington Post reported that Iranian officials said Tehran aims to keep oil prices high ahead of the US midterm elections.

subject: hh,lng_export
text: Record LNG feedgas lifts US natural gas futures. Natural Gas Intelligence reported record LNG feedgas demand lifted Henry Hub futures, outweighing the return of TCO supply.

subject: india_omc,inr
text: Trump's Russia sanctions waiver eases India's energy woes and lifts trade-deal chances. Reuters reported the US waiver of new Russia sanctions eases India's access to Russian crude and improves the odds of a US-India trade deal.

subject: re_miners
text: European Commission to fund rare-earth magnet production in Estonia. ERR News reported the European Commission will fund rare-earth magnet production in Estonia, part of efforts to reduce reliance on China.

subject: homebuilders,consumer
text: US homebuilder sentiment falls to 29 in October, lowest since 2012. The NAHB housing market index fell to 29 in October from 32, below a 31 forecast and the lowest reading since 2012.

subject: fed_hike
text: Hassett says September CPI shows inflation 'needs some work'. White House economic adviser Kevin Hassett said the latest CPI data show inflation still needs work, as strong spending complicates the Fed's path.

subject: gulf_war,risk_on
text: Saudi Arabia to postpone in-person 'Davos in the Desert' after Houthi attacks. The FT reported Saudi Arabia will postpone the in-person Future Investment Initiative after Houthi attacks; Fars separately reported sirens and an explosion in Riyadh the same hour.

subject: container,freight
text: Strait of Hormuz scoured for spilt cargo after Iran attacks container ships. The Guardian reported searches for lost cargo after attacks on container ships in Hormuz; Singapore-flagged feeder GFS Pride sank with its containers aboard and all 21 crew evacuated.

subject: autos
text: China vows to 'resolutely counter' if UK restricts Chinese EVs. China's commerce ministry said it will resolutely counter if the UK insists on restrictive measures against Chinese electric vehicles, which the UK is reported to be weighing to align with the EU.

subject: hh
text: US taps $42 million in wartime-law funding for the Constitution gas pipeline. Bloomberg reported the US will use $42 million of Defense Production Act funding to help build the stalled Constitution natural gas pipeline into New York.

subject: dram,autos
text: Rivian CEO says memory prices add 'many hundreds of dollars' per vehicle. Rivian's CEO said surging memory chip prices are adding many hundreds of dollars to the cost of each vehicle.

subject: gold
text: Gold stalls below $4,200 as Fed rate-hike bets limit upside. Gold held below $4,200 an ounce on Monday as bets on Fed rate hikes after hot inflation data capped gains.

subject: em_fx
text: Turkey's capital markets regulator chief resigns amid fund crisis. Anadolu Agency reported the head of Turkey's Capital Markets Board resigned amid a crisis in the fund industry.

subject: defense
text: Department of War and BAE Systems sign framework to surge counter-drone production. The US Department of War and BAE Systems signed a framework agreement to surge production of counter-drone systems.

subject: china_controls
text: US sanctions five entities tied to Chinese national Ding over alleged AI trade-secret theft. Treasury's OFAC issued its first PAIPA designations, sanctioning five entities connected to Chinese national Ding over alleged trade-secret theft, with associated general licenses.

subject: gulf_war,brent,freight,airlines
text: Houthis claim strikes on Saudi Shaybah oilfield, Aramco Yanbu site and Riyadh and Abha airports. Yemen's Houthis said they attacked Saudi energy, airport and military targets including the Shaybah oilfield, an Aramco site in Yanbu, King Khalid airport in Riyadh and Abha airport; Saudi damage was not confirmed in the report.

subject: gulf_war,tankers
text: Iranian supreme leader's adviser calls claims that Hormuz is open 'baseless'. An adviser to Iran's supreme leader told Tasnim the claim that the Strait of Hormuz is open is baseless.

subject: inflation,us_yields
text: Scotiabank and BMO now expect a 25 bp Bank of Canada hike next week. After September CPI rose to 3.1%, Scotiabank and BMO both said they expect the Bank of Canada to raise rates by 25 bp at next week's decision; BoC surveys also showed higher inflation expectations.

subject: russia_war
text: Russian strike kills six in Kharkiv region as Zelensky says US is delaying 'vital supplies'. Ukraine said a Russian attack killed six people at a park in the Kharkiv region, including three children; Zelensky said Russia struck without warning from partners and the US was delaying vital supplies.

subject: ai_chips
text: The Information: DeepSeek working with Huawei on AI chip designs for next year. The Information reported DeepSeek is working with Huawei Technologies on new AI chip designs for next year.

subject: bitcoin,crypto_stocks
text: Strive buys $335 million of bitcoin, lifting holdings to 36,818 BTC. Strive said it bought about $335 million of bitcoin, taking its holdings to 36,818 BTC.

subject: inr,em_fx
text: India shelves coal import plan as high global prices and weak rupee raise costs. Times of India reported India shelved a coal import plan because high global coal prices and a weak rupee made imports too costly.

subject: cocoa,chocolate
text: Cocoa prices rise on smaller Ivory Coast port deliveries. Barchart reported cocoa futures rose as Ivory Coast farmers' cocoa deliveries to ports lagged last year's pace.

subject: devices,dram
text: India smartphone shipments plunge 26% in Q3; Samsung leads. India's smartphone shipments fell 26% year on year in the third quarter, with Samsung the market leader, per a market-tracker report.

subject: ai_capex,ai_chips,risk_on
text: CoreWeave jumps on Goldman Sachs upgrade as AI stocks rebound; Nasdaq up over 1%. CoreWeave shares jumped after a Goldman Sachs upgrade and AI-linked stocks recovered, lifting the Nasdaq more than 1% ahead of key earnings; Marvell rose 6% and Broadcom 3%.

subject: fed_hike,gold
text: Gold edges higher as traders ease Fed rate-hike bets after Warsh speech. Bloomberg reported gold edged higher as traders pared bets on a Fed rate hike following a speech by Fed Chair Kevin Warsh.

subject: crypto_reg
text: Google to allow certified crypto exchange and wallet ads in the UAE from October 21. Google said that from October 21, 2026, crypto exchange, wallet, CFD and forex advertisers in the UAE may run ads if Google-certified.

subject: brent,oil_majors,airlines
text: WTI settles up 2.2% at $103.66 and Brent tops $109 after Houthi strikes on Saudi targets. NYMEX WTI settled at $103.66, up $2.25 (2.22%), while Brent futures touched above $109 before settling at $109.55, down 31 cents, after Houthi claims of strikes on Saudi airports and Aramco facilities.

subject: gulf_war,brent
text: Tasnim: Yemeni drone attacks on Dammam halt airport activity. Iran's Tasnim News reported Yemeni drone attacks on Dammam in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province and said activity at Dammam airport was halted; not independently confirmed.

subject: red_sea,freight,container
text: IRGC says it can extend the blockade to Bab al-Mandeb and Suez, warns on Hormuz undersea cables. An IRGC spokesman said Tehran has not fully closed the Strait of Hormuz and can expand the blockade to the Bab al-Mandeb Strait and Suez Canal, and separately pointed to seven major data cables under Hormuz.

subject: tankers,freight
text: US to let dark-fleet tankers shed sanctions, Energy Secretary Wright says. Energy Secretary Chris Wright said the US will allow sanctioned 'dark fleet' tankers to shed sanctions, adding that dozens to hundreds of vessels could be converted, as record tanker rates hurt US crude demand.

subject: gulf_war
text: Iran says US forces attacked Konark naval base; US official calls claim inaccurate. Iran's navy said US forces attacked the Konark naval base in the morning, firing at a 35 mm cannon; a US official told CNN the claim was inaccurate.

subject: hh,f_gas
text: US natural gas settles at $3.058 on milder weather outlook. NYMEX November natural gas settled at $3.058/MMBtu, falling on a milder weather outlook and weaker demand expectations despite record LNG feedgas earlier.

subject: steel
text: Cleveland-Cliffs postpones Burns Harbor blast furnace reline to 2028. Cleveland-Cliffs pushed the reline of its Burns Harbor, Indiana blast furnace to 2028, keeping the furnace running instead of taking it down for maintenance.

subject: coffee,coffee_chains
text: Coffee prices jump on El Niño risks. Coffee futures rose on concern that El Niño could hurt crops in Brazil and Asia.

subject: lng_export
text: FERC proposes blanket authorization to speed LNG approvals. FERC unanimously proposed a blanket certificate program for certain LNG facility activities and a draft policy dropping air dispersion modeling requirements for gas projects.

subject: hyperscalers,ai_capex
text: S&P Global flags potentially hidden AI debt at hyperscalers. S&P Global warned that hyperscalers may carry hidden AI-related debt through off-balance-sheet structures as AI spending surges.

subject: crypto_reg

subject: crypto_stocks
text: Coinbase links US and offshore crypto derivatives via Deribit. Coinbase connected its US and offshore crypto derivatives markets through Deribit.
